positions.title: R&D Software Engineer / QA Engineer
positions.description:
Secret Clearance 

R&D Software Engineer: 
- Full stack developer for web-based training simulation while integrating interactive maps and data layers. 
- Use of ISO Standards in accordance with stakeholders' requirements and needs. 
- Built and sustained full stack features across various projects using Angular/MaterialUI, React/Mantine, Python, Java, Docker, C#, OpenLayers, GeoServer, and OpenLayers. 

QA Engineer:
- Spearheaded impactful virtual training verification events with meaningful client relations and maximized internal testing efforts through detailed Jira backlog management.
- Planned and prioritized testing procedures in collaboration with stakeholders, translating requirements into actionable tasks.
positions.insights: Skills: Product R&D · Agile Methodologies · React.js · Mantine · AngularJS · QA Engineering · User Interface Design · Client Relations · Docker Products · OpenLayers · Python (Programming Language) · C#

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
Toni Jennings Exceptional Education Institute (TJEEI) is dedicated to preparing and retaining exceptional student education teachers and professional educators who serve children and adults with special needs.

• Primary developer for ModelMe and SelfQuest projects to teach special education students various levels of math, science, and reading comprehension with scrum ideologies.
• Responsible for web development and maintenance and social media content for five programs in the institute increasing student interest by 12%.
• Use of JavaScript, HTML/CSS, PHP, Figma, WordPress with Elementor
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · Elementor · Figma (Software) · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Front-End Development · Back-End Web Development · User Experience (UX) · Canva · WordPress Design · HTML

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern - Google Chat
positions.description:
• Developed a new Google Chat feature within the Android team that focuses on showcasing important usage metrics in a digestible recap.
• Planned feature architecture, estimated milestones and deadlines, incorporated latest Android MVVM principles, and drove the feature from data to UI.
• Use of Kotlin, Java, Android Studio
positions.insights: Skills: Android Development · Data Management · Model-view-viewmodel (MVVM) · Kotlin · User Experience (UX)

positions.title: STEP Intern - Payment Risk
positions.description:

• Responsible for implementing a model management system which relied on a typescript based back-end and Java based front-end.
• Use of Typescript with Angular, Java, HTML/CSS, Figma.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Web Development · Data Management · Angular · Agile Methodologies · User Experience (UX) · TypeScript · Full-Stack Development
